external/ — third-party trees, and which of them are in the repo.

Two kinds live here, and the difference is whether anything in the tree
actually reads them.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
COMMITTED — something depends on these
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

mathjax/          mathjax@3.2.2, the npm distribution package (es5/ builds).
svgo/
texsvg/           Extracted manually from a package installed by
                  `npm install .` from master at this commit:
                  https://github.com/remarkablemark/texsvg/commit/9dc7367a4db19bb4f9964ea48259a5ccc35ee1ff
                  Extract these manually, just pulling out the source
                  directories.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NOT COMMITTED — reading copies, restore on demand
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Gitignored. Nothing in Matematex/ or test/ imports from any of them, and
none is a build input. They are here so the KaTeX and MathJax sources can
be READ, which is this project's working rule: every layout rule we need
is already written down in KaTeX's source, its CSS and its emitted HTML,
so read it rather than infer it from measurements. That rule has paid for
itself repeatedly — accent placement came straight out of accent.js
(`left = skew − accentWidth/2`) and katex.scss stating outright that
`.accent-body:not(.accent-full) { width: 0 }`.

Roughly 50 MB between them, restored in a minute, so they are not worth
carrying in every clone forever.

KaTeX-0.16.22/          katex@0.16.22, the GitHub SOURCE tree — not the
                        npm tarball, which ships dist/ without src/.
                        The files worth reading are src/fontMetricsData.js,
                        src/functions/*.js and src/styles/katex.scss.

    curl -L https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/archive/refs/tags/v0.16.22.tar.gz \
      | tar xz -C external/

    (GitHub strips the tag's leading "v", so this unpacks straight to
     external/KaTeX-0.16.22/ — no rename needed. If the directory name
     comes out different, fix it: the version is part of the path on
     purpose, so an upgrade cannot be mistaken for the old copy.)

MathJax-src-3.2.2/      mathjax-full@3.2.2, likewise the source tree.

    curl -L https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-src/archive/refs/tags/3.2.2.tar.gz \
      | tar xz -C external/

@types/web/             @types/web@0.0.256. Referenced only by
                        proto/domzero/package.json, which restores it
                        itself via `npm install`.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
WHAT THE BUILD AND THE TESTS ACTUALLY USE
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Everything derived from KaTeX is already committed, so a fresh clone
builds and every test runs with external/KaTeX-0.16.22 absent:

  Matematex/Assets/ProjectScripts/katex_bundle.ts
      dist/katex.mjs from katex@0.16.22, unmodified.

  Matematex/Assets/ProjectScripts/KaTeXFontMetrics.ts
      The metrics tables, transcribed from src/fontMetricsData.js.
      Main-Regular, Math-Italic, Main-Bold, Math-BoldItalic and
      Size1–Size4.

  test/layout-conformance/reference/
      katex.mjs   a byte copy of katex_bundle.ts, so the browser
                  reference and our walker run the SAME build — zero
                  version skew, which is what makes every delta our bug.
      katex.css   compiled from src/styles/katex.scss.
      fonts/      the 22 .woff2 faces. A real directory, NOT a symlink
                  into external/, so the browser capture step works on a
                  fresh clone too.
      index.html  references katex.css, which references fonts/ — all
                  relative.

Regenerating katex.css after a KaTeX upgrade needs the source tree back:

    ln -sfn ../../../external/KaTeX-0.16.22/fonts test/layout-conformance/reference/fonts
    printf '$font-folder: "fonts";\n@import "katex.scss";\n' > /tmp/katex-wrap.scss
    npx --yes sass --no-source-map \
      --load-path=external/KaTeX-0.16.22/src/styles \
      /tmp/katex-wrap.scss test/layout-conformance/reference/katex.css

Replace the symlink with a real copy of the fonts afterwards.
